summary: Defines the RegulatoryCompliance module that enforces reporting obligations and holds for settlement transactions based on notional thresholds ($10M/$25M) and cross-border criteria ($5M). Covers event-driven workflow for regulatory reporting via SFTP, suspicious transaction flags to FIU, audit attachment, and seven-year record retention requirements.
